items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: They recommended me and I went and auditioned for Herb Alpert. He said, “Well you can have the gig, you can certainly do the gig but I want you to move back to L.A.”

ctx.x: You know Steve Gilmore said that he thinks he missed some work because people thought oh well he plays with Phil Woods. He’s not going to be able to do anything else.

Well Steve was very busy before he was working with Phil doing Broadway shows, subbing and playing with a lot of people. And he, you know, it could be, but I just had to make that choice. Because I’d always wanted to play with Bill Evans. That was a band that was — traveled all the time. And that’s what we were getting into with Phil, and you know that was a band that nobody knew really. We started to get well known, we started to get gigs, and it was something like, you know you’d get an opportunity to start…
